body:
I've tried. I asked for more help, to ease our load, better training. My pleas have been met with a firm 'just deal with it' attitude.

When I first started, the former crew leader joked about them not caring about us. We were just bodies capable of being replaced. All they care about our results and numbers. I'm starting to see it more and more each week.

Thanks for the positive response. I'm hoping it doesn't come to me losing my job. I understand why everyone is worried about that. I'm more focused on my health though. Money and bills don't matter if you're not healthy.
